data.text:
Ali Hemati vs Food Safety Officer on 5 December, 2024 
Bench: J.K. Maheshwari, Rajesh Bindal  1  ITEM NO.11 COURT NO.7 SECTION II-C  S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A  RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS  Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No(s). 7909/2023  [Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 24-02-2023  in CRLOP No. 31363/2022 passed by the High Court of Judicature at  Madras]
 ALI HEMATI & ORS. Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS  FOOD SAFETY OFFICER Respondent(s)
 (IA No. 123625/2023 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT IA No. 125384/2023 - PERMISSION TO FILE ADDITIONAL  DOCUMENTS/FACTS/ANNEXURES)
 Date : 05-12-2024 These matters were called on for hearing today. 
 CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.K. MAHESHWARI  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH BINDAL  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Arunabh Chowdhury, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Varun Satiya, Adv.
 Mr. Karma Dorjee, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1. Even after service of notice, none appears on behalf of the Food Safety Officer, who may be represented through the State counsel. 
2. Considering the aforesaid, fresh notice, returnable in four weeks be issued to the Food Safety Officer and a copy of the petition be served on the standing counsel for the State, namely, Mr. D.
Kumanan. The Registry is directed to reflect his name in the cause list on the next date of listing. 
Ali Hemati vs Food Safety Officer on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112268139/
1 3. A copy of this order be sent by the Registry to the Chief Secretary and the Law Secretary of the State of Tamil Nadu indicating the fact that in this Court, no one is representing the State. Even in Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No. 2778 of 2022, which has been disposed of today, despite service of notice, no one had appeared. 
4. The Chief Secretary and the Law Secretary of the State shall take appropriate steps to ensure presence of counsel before this Court. 
5. List the matter in the month of January, 2025.
(GULSHAN KUMAR ARORA) (NAND KISHOR)
